productChange: Validate only mediaID as UUID; validate exact current canonical stage version 1 and display/thumbnail/video variant separately.
rootCause: The registered stage-content GET incorrectly passed numeric mediaVersion and textual variant to the common UUID-only path validator, making every legitimate thumbnail request return invalid_human_control before the native reader.
remoteReadOnlyDiagnostic: device14-video-poster-diagnostic01/receipt.json establishes retained successful canonical Stage and matching stored byte hashes. The failing HTTP status was not observed in retained access logs; the deterministic UUID guard rejection was established from source.
